|lore=Gruff, surly, no-blasters-allowed bartender. Hates droids. 'We don't serve their kind here.' Wants to concoct the perfect drink for Jabba so he can work as his personal bartender.
|game_text=While at Cantina, each player may only fire one weapon during battle here and, while Jabba on table, opponent generates no Force here. Once per game, may take Restraining Bolt into hand from Reserve Deck (reshuffle) or retrieve Restraining Bolt.

* '''Original''' ([[Wuher (V)]]): the card image at official release (20 July 2024, with the Virtual Set 23 release images)<ref name="ht-335d47f">Players Committee card image, [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/335d47f6b929debedbac9376b863af4442469f36/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual23-Dark/large/wuher.gif as uploaded] to the PC's Holotable image repository (served at [https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/Virtual23-Dark/large/wuher.gif res.starwarsccg.org]) in commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/335d47f6b929debedbac9376b863af4442469f36 335d47f] “Set 23 new images”, 20 July 2024, with the Virtual Set 23 release images.</ref> prints: “While at Cantina, each player may only fire one weapon during battle here and, while Jabba on table, opponent generates no Force here. Once per game, may take Restraining Bolt into hand from Reserve Deck (reshuffle) or retrieve Restraining Bolt.” '''What changed:''' The words of the game text are unchanged. The round icon at the right edge of the card, beside the game-text box, sits lower than on the first image (the December 2023 preview). It is a version of its own because the PC published a visibly different card image (Bill, 12 November 2026: every visible change on a PC image is its own version). The card image prints no errata mark.
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Wuher (V) (Errata)]]): Slip on the Players Committee's Virtual Set 23 release sheet with errata (Set-23-Plus-Errata.pdf)<ref name="sheet23-20240802">Players Committee, [https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-23-Plus-Errata.pdf Virtual Set 23 release sheet with errata] (PDF, 9 pages, footer “SWCCG Players Committee, July 2024”; file created 2 August 2024). Released with [[Virtual Set 23]] (22 July 2024); the PDF is dated by its creation date.</ref>, page 2, file created 2 August 2024: “While at Cantina, each player may only fire one weapon during battle here and, while Jabba on table, opponent generates no Force here. Once per game, may take Restraining Bolt into hand from Reserve Deck (reshuffle) or retrieve Restraining Bolt.” '''What changed:''' Same words as [[Wuher (V)]] (Original). The sheet prints a partial slip under the label “•Wuher”: the lower part of the PC card image of [[Wuher (V)]] (published 21 July 2024) — the bars and game-text box down to the lower-left name — pixel for pixel the same, to be laid over the card named in its lower-left corner ([[Wuher]]). A separate Players Committee publication, so its own version (Bill, 11 and 12 November 2026: every publication is a version; a release-sheet slip and the PC card image are separate printings). '''Errata mark:''' the slip prints no errata mark, but it is errata 1 in release order; recorded as printed and listed as a [[Players Committee transcription errors|PC transcription error]] (Bill, 12 November 2026).
